transcript.text: To help me narrow this down, could you tell me what happens when you press the start button? Do any lights or a digital display turn on, or is the machine completely silent and dark? Also, please confirm if this is a vented tumble dryer (exhausts air outside) or a condenser/heat-pump model.
Lights come on, programme lights too, but nothing happens when I press start, no sound at all. It's a Hotpoint condenser.

Since the lights are on but the drum doesn't turn when you press start, the most likely cause is that the machine isn't detecting that the door is closed. This is usually due to a faulty door switch or the latch not engaging properly.

The machine is likely refusing to start because it doesn't think the door is securely shut. This is almost always due to the door catch mechanism or the switch itself. Please unplug the dryer first for safety. Then, look at the latch on the door frame and see if it's broken or loose. Close the door firmly and listen carefully for a click; if you don't hear one, or if the plastic looks damaged, that is your fault. If it clicks but still won't start, we may need to look at the internal switch.

Just checked. No click, the door swings back slightly open. The plastic tongue on the door has snapped off, found the piece on the floor. If I hold the door firmly shut and press start it runs, stops when I let go.

That suggests the issue is mechanical. The machine won't start because it doesn't detect the door is closed; holding it shut bypasses this safety interlock. This is an owner-replaceable part on most Hotpoint condenser dryers, though it usually requires removing the top panel and sometimes the front panel or control console to access the mounting screws. Once you have the correct replacement part for your specific model number, fitting it should resolve the problem immediately.
